criteria.criterion: athena_core::capability::Capability has a default no-op job-start hook returning a brief note and extra env. Change keeps the default, and Study overrides it.
criteria.evidence: capability.rs adds `fn on_job_start(&self, _start: &JobStart) -> Result<StartOutcome>` with default `Ok(StartOutcome::default())`. StartOutcome holds note, env and mounts. cap-change is untouched; the lifecycle test checks that Change.on_job_start returns the default. Study overrides it in athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs.

criteria.criterion: run.rs calls the hook at job start before the producer. The note appears in the producer and verifier briefs, and the env reaches both agents.
criteria.evidence: run.rs dispatch calls capability.on_job_start before the producer brief is built, and passes start.note to ProducerInputs. RunContext carries `start`. The producer and the verifier both get capability_env extended with start.env, in the same function that builds check_env. VerifierInputs.start_note is set. briefs.rs renders a '## Job start' section in both briefs.

criteria.criterion: athena.toml gains [capabilities.study] (named in this criterion) with the firstmate URL, a branch of main, and offline cargo grants and env. It holds no hard-coded SHA.
criteria.evidence: athena.toml adds [capabilities.study] with source_url = https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate, source_branch = main, and producer/verifier cargo grants without run/fmt/clippy. [capabilities.study.env] sets CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true. The section has no SHA, and a unit test asserts this.

criteria.criterion: Study resolves the configured branch to a full 40-hex SHA when a study starts, checks out that SHA, verifies HEAD equals it, and records it. A missing URL, failed resolution or mismatch gives a clear error.
criteria.evidence: source.rs: resolve_branch runs `git ls-remote -- url refs/heads/<branch>` and requires exactly one full 40-hex SHA (is_full_sha). fetch_pinned clones, runs `checkout --detach <sha>`, then verify_head. The SHA goes into the note (recorded in the committed brief-producer.md) and into the ATHENA_STUDY_SOURCE_SHA env. Missing URL or branch, an unknown branch, a failed ls-remote and a HEAD mismatch each give a descriptive error, and tests cover all of them.

criteria.criterion: The pinned tree sits inside each agent's confined working directory (producer and verifier snapshots), read-only, and is excluded from the change list and admission. The path named in the brief resolves inside the policy root.
criteria.evidence: Snapshot::mount_read_only copies the tree to `pinned-source/` without .git, clears the files' write bits, and adds `/pinned-source/` to .git/info/exclude. work_tree_tree uses `git add -A`, so the mount stays out of the change list, the admission list and the verifier's prepared tree. run.rs mounts it in both the producer and verifier snapshots and passes Policy.read_only. confine_for denies writes under read-only paths. The note names `pinned-source/`, which is relative to the snapshot root.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test. A dispatch-level test with a fake capability shows the hook ran, its note reached the brief and its env reached the agents. It fails if the run.rs call is removed.
criteria.evidence: the_job_start_hook_runs_before_the_producer_and_reaches_both_agents passed. Its fake `Starting` capability counts hook calls and asserts the count is 1 when the producer runs. It asserts the note is in both agents' prompts and in the committed brief-producer.md, that STARTED_BY_HOOK=yes is in both agents' env, that the mount is visible to both agents, and that the candidate change list is only README.md. Without the run.rs call, the note, env and mount assertions would all fail.

findings.summary: The earlier CHANGELOG entry now contradicts the new one
findings.evidence: The existing Unreleased line still says the study capability 'has no configured checks or commands yet', but this change adds study command grants in athena.toml.

findings.summary: Full single-branch clone on every study start
findings.evidence: fetch_pinned runs `git clone --no-checkout --single-branch` with full history. If the branch moves between ls-remote and clone, the resolved SHA may be missing from the clone and checkout fails (with a clear error). D75's tradeoff notes the cost.

findings.summary: Files changed beyond the expected deliverables list
findings.evidence: source.rs, briefs.rs, config.rs, snapshot.rs, live.rs and architecture.md are also changed. Each is needed for the hook, the note rendering, the config fields or the mount, so none is unrelated scope.

summary: The change does what the reading asks. Capability gains a no-op on_job_start hook by default; change keeps the default and study overrides it. run.rs calls the hook at dispatch, before the producer brief is written. The hook's note goes into both briefs, its env goes to both agents and the checks, and its read-only mounts are copied into both snapshots. The mounts are kept out of the change list via .git/info/exclude, and a policy read_only list denies writes to them. Study resolves the configured branch with git ls-remote, requires a single full 40-hex SHA, clones and checks out that SHA, verifies HEAD equals it, and records the SHA in the committed producer brief and in an env var. athena.toml gains [capabilities.study] with the firstmate URL, branch main, offline cargo grants and env, and no SHA. I ran the dispatch-level hook test, the study tests (local git repo; Read, Grep and Glob accepted; mount absent from the change list), the catalog/schema test, and fmt, clippy and the full test suite; all passed. Two minor issues remain: an earlier CHANGELOG line is now stale, and every start does a full-history clone.
